answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wharf of the next round. What survives to the river is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on invitation quota tree, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing.
